CompanyOverview.description:
Covered posted activity and as-of positions over one verified owner cut.

``top_expenses`` lists at most five ledgers with a positive net. ``other_expenses`` is the
net of *every other* expense ledger, so it can be negative when one of them ends with a
credit balance (purchase returns, say). It is never clamped:
``sum(top_expenses.amount) + other_expenses == totals.expenses`` exactly.

other_expenses.description: Net of every expense ledger outside top_expenses; may be negative. sum(top_expenses) + other_expenses equals totals.expenses exactly.
other_expenses.title: Other Expenses

Gstr1Context.description: Outward-return authority with the shared calculation-revision contract.
Gstr1Context.title: Gstr1Context

OverviewBuckets.description: Bills by days past due at the period end; ``unknown`` has no due date.
OverviewBuckets.title: OverviewBuckets

OverviewLedger.description: An expense ledger whose net for the period is a positive amount (a debit balance).
OverviewLedger.title: OverviewLedger

OverviewOpenItems.description: One role's open bills: ``gross`` less ``advances`` is ``net``; ``overdue`` is gross.
OverviewOpenItems.title: OverviewOpenItems

OverviewParty.description:
One party, however many ledgers it holds: balances are summed across them.

``name`` is the party's own name (a ledger's name only if the source carries none).
``outstanding`` is bills less unapplied credit; ``overdue`` is bills past due.
OverviewParty.title: OverviewParty

OverviewPosition.description: Closing cash plus bank balance at the end of one day.
OverviewPosition.title: OverviewPosition

RoundingMode.description: ``company.rounding_mode`` values, mapped to Python rounding constants.
RoundingMode.title: RoundingMode
